topic: Visual polish, organic field motion, and progression feedback
currentUserGoal: Make the redesign look polished and run well, remove visual bugs, desynchronize grass animation, and make equipment and Memory choices feel animated and satisfying.
workCompleted: Added deterministic per-root motion profiles with unique phase, breath, sway, bob, tilt, and spark speeds.
Added a low-amplitude second harmonic to grass breath, sway, and bob so neighboring roots no longer look like offset copies of one sine wave.
Kept all root motion values precomputed and allocation-free during frame updates.
Fixed the Scourge HUD label that visually collapsed into phaseactive by adding an explicit separator and uppercase phase label.
Moved the Scourge pressure bar below its label on desktop and compact HUDs to remove text/bar overlap.
Added subtle affordability breathing to equipment rows without animating locked rows.
Added equipment install feedback: RT motes travel from the HUD, the row flashes, the icon snaps, and a tinted install ring expands from the helper.
Added a restrained red rejection flash for blocked equipment purchases.
Added persistent upper-arc rank pips to multi-rank Memory nodes.
Added Memory purchase rings, branch-colored flecks, rank-pip activation, and a stronger completion variant.
Added a restrained rejection pulse for blocked Memory purchases.
Fixed Memory purchase float text to use transformed screen bounds, so feedback appears over the correct node after tree zooming or panning.
Verified the 1x1 and 2x2 active fields, equipment shop, desktop Grove, compact phone HUD, and compact phone Grove.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 81 Vitest tests across ten files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Root-motion tests confirm profiles are deterministic, differ between neighboring roots, and remain within restrained animation bounds.
A real desktop run reached the 2x2 field at 38 earned RT and showed varied textures, clean HUD spacing, and stable active-field composition.
A real equipment purchase spent 15 RT, advanced Tiny Sprinkler to x1, and raised its next price to 20 RT.
A real Memory purchase advanced Soft Touch to 3/10 and updated its pips, card, next effect, and next cost.
Desktop and phone browser consoles contained no errors or warnings.
The required 1,200-tile performance harness completed every phase with zero frame spikes, zero layout passes, zero queued redraws, and a final 129 fps / 8 ms max-frame sample.

release.status: Local checkpoint only; not pushed, merged, or deployed.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/field-equipment-recast branch.
The preceding ranked-memory foundation is commit 126cbe5.
knownIssues: The repository performance harness exercises the large legacy field path; the redesign-specific visual pass was verified through real 1x1 and 2x2 browser runs plus allocation-free code review.
The playtest utility overlay covers bottom content at 390px; it is only present under ?playtest and is absent from the normal game.
The local in-app browser playtest save is now Soft Touch 3/10 with 33 GT because real Memory purchase feedback was verified.
Rank pips are intentionally compact at whole-web overview scale and become clearer when the tree is zoomed.
nextRecommendedSteps: Run a normal-speed hands-on playtest with audio enabled and tune effect intensity by feel rather than adding more effects immediately.
Add a small redesign-only frame-time sample to the browser debug state if the active field grows beyond 25 roots.
Polish equipment-specific idle personalities once helper mechanics become distinct instead of giving every helper the same motion language.
Continue the Memory Web with additional ranked nodes and branch keystones.
doNotRevert: Keep root motion deterministic and allocation-free inside animateScene.
Keep the Scourge pressure bar physically separate from its text label.
Keep locked equipment visually quiet and reserve breathing emphasis for affordable choices.
Keep Memory purchase feedback inside the masked tree container while float text uses transformed screen coordinates.
Keep persistent rank pips tied to each node's maxRank rather than hard-coding Soft Touch.
